text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, Fine Motion and Air
Groove have
a photo shoot in their
signature racewear for a
feature article
in the academy newspaper.

text_block_list.name: Academy Newspaper Member
text_block_list.text:
Fine, Air Groove, could you look a little
more in
this direction, please?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay. How's this?

text_block_list.name: Academy Newspaper Member
text_block_list.text:
Perfect! You two were definitely the
right people
to ask for our feature on
"dignified signature
racewear"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing. I'm glad that you're
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me, didn't you once say
your
signature wear was a testament to
your feelings?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion nods with a smile. It's just
like the
very first time she donned her
signature
racewear...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Does it suit me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thanks, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if you really like it that much,
should we get
you a jacket with the
same design?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion keeps teasing me as we
make our
way to the press conference
we called to reveal
her signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being a foreign dignitary, even the
completion of
Fine Motion's signature
racewear is major news,
and the press
shows up in droves.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It is through the enduring support of so
many
others that I have the honor of
donning this
signature racewear today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wish to express my deep gratitude to
both my
loving fans and all others who
have helped me
along the way.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Would you mind
sharing your
future aspirations with us?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I will endeavor to run with everything I
have and
without vanity, so as to bring
honor to Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What do you say to those who believe
your
devotion to running might have a
negative impact
on the performance of
your public duties?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please take a look at my signature
racewear.
There are shamrocks inlayed in
several places,
which represent promises.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This racewear symbolizes my oath to
Ireland and
is also a testament to my
own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My pride, my ideals I wish to illustrate,
the future
I walk—all of these things are
forever intertwined
with my home.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ireland has never once left my mind, and
will ever
be in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I will continue to devote my full
abilities to
this endeavor. I wish to do
the people proud,
both as a racer and as
a representative of Ireland
on this
international stage.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It is only natural for some to harbor
concerns, but
that is all the more reason
to watch me run and
ascertain my
resolve for yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! My feelings... My pride...
won't allow
it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! She's right at the heels of the
Empress!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
I'll be honest—I thought she was just
some rich
girl doing this for thrills, but
she might be the real
deal!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I've done all I can. We have a
saying in
English, and I think you have a
similar one in
Japan: "We propose, the
gods dispose."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's hope so.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
From our birth and environment to our

preferences and beliefs—no two people
are alike.
That's why I'm sure it'll be
difficult to gain
everyone's
understanding.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But if my feelings are able to reach even
one of
you watching this press
conference today, I'll be
happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It appears the photo shoot finished
smoothly
while I was taking my stroll
down memory lane.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Here you are, Trainer! Here, I've got a
present for
you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm honored to hear you say
that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When I put this signature racewear on,
it's like my
whole body tenses. I feel like
it's driving me
onwards.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I have to show everyone that
I'm not
playing around!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It appears the photo shoot finished
smoothly
while I was taking my stroll
down memory lane.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Here you are, Trainer! Here, I've got a
present for
you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I found this during the photo shoot. It's
not a
jacket, but we'll still match if you
wear it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After saying this, Fine Motion hands me
a
clover—or a shamrock, rather.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll continue running for as long as time
permits.
I'll go as far as I can...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
With you, the person who shares my
ambitions,
by my side!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pin that proof of her promise to my
chest as a
way of honoring her trust and
determination.
